title: Roll for AGI
creator: rollforagi
direct_result: The game launched into an interactive hand-drawn dice/board scene. A roll moved to an Empty Lot and opened a build choice; selecting Text built a Text house. After dismissing the tutorial, the board showed 20/40 points, 10 Tokens × 2 Params = 20, and a further house/GPU choice.
actions: Confirmed the Sound control was aria-pressed=false before play.
Clicked Roll; waited for the animation to settle.
Selected the Text house build option in the in-game tutorial.
Clicked Skip tutorial; the board then resolved the house trigger and showed the resulting score.
gameplay_response: After Skip tutorial, the game showed a resolved Text house trigger, changed the score to 20/40, and exposed the This Text house action with Add GPU 4. This is direct control/response proof, not merely menu or HTTP success.
mechanics_evidence: Observed: dice roll on a board, Token × Params scoring, property/house choice, cash, tutorial progression. Game UI named the first encounter Pop Quiz and its move Skim.
art_evidence: The live page has custom game-specific hand-drawn dice, grid board, colored cards and score UI. Existing page art is already specific; preserve it if used as the card image unless a future review finds a placeholder catalog image.

thumbnail_concepts.label: A
thumbnail_concepts.concept: Large hand-drawn die landing on a highlighted Text house, with the Token × Params score jumping toward 40/40; keep the notebook/grid style and clean, legible numbers.

thumbnail_concepts.label: B
thumbnail_concepts.concept: A tilted game-board crop with the Pop Quiz boss card and its Skim move facing a bright die roll, score bar close to full; preserve the marker-and-pencil drawing language.

audio_note: The game's Sound button was confirmed aria-pressed=false before Start. Parent later required all tabs closed because the user still heard audio; cause was not isolated, so parent owns audio remediation before any retest.
source: existing AI Game Scout; candidate manifest in ../run.json
